name: PLA
notes: The default for miniatures — cheap, stiff, crisp detail

name: PETG
notes: Tough and slightly heavier than PLA — terrain and functional parts

name: ABS
notes: Lightest common filament — needs an enclosure

name: ASA
notes: UV-stable ABS alternative for outdoor prints

name: TPU
notes: Flexible rubber-like material — banners, tracks, tires

name: Nylon (PA12)
notes: Strong and slightly hygroscopic — engineering parts

name: PLA-CF
notes: Carbon-fiber filled PLA — fillers push the density up

name: Resin — Standard
notes: General purpose photopolymer — usually printed solid

name: Resin — Tough
notes: Higher impact resistance for functional resin parts

name: Resin — ABS-Like
notes: The most common upgrade resin for miniatures

name: Resin — Flexible
notes: Rubber-like photopolymer for tires and gaskets
